summary: Critical files missing: ArtifactCleanup.Tests.ps1 (referenced in workflow line 28), fixture JSON files (basic-maxage.json, keep-latest.json, combined.json; all copied in run-act-tests.ps1 lines 47-54), and .actrc (line 43).
